name: deep-research-skills
description: True deep research skills that go beyond surface search: extensive multi-database literature investigation, cross-domain dot-connection, source-provenance control, evidence appraisal, and citation verification. Covers published medical literature (medical-research-detective) and auditing video claims against the primary sources they cite, with A+ to F grading on source fidelity, comprehensiveness, and statistics (video-source-audit).
